rules.condition: A rule or ADR is published on an in-force surface
rules.obligation: It has a testable default-closed gate, or it is removed
One ADR list; rules carry corpus nlc or bba
It is if/then: condition + obligation + gate
Plan decomposes to atomic actions; each action is gated and validated against the plan
ADRs bind to actions; reverse audit fails if an applicable ADR is unbound
Emit produces artifact + JSON manifest; schema is predefined; unused fields are na; trace and thought anchors present; emit is audited; bound-ADR gates run immediately and default-closed
rules.gate: partial: ADR 0010 gate-record; expansion: full manifest schema
